[[File:PowerSurge-HOBS.png|thumb|right|300px|The central power distribution grid]]
The '''central power distribution grid''' was located 5,000 levels down from the surface of [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It provided electrical power to the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-world]], going to many districts, including the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this facility was [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|destroyed]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]].
